Hiring: Senior Software Engineers (LATAM/US/Canada-based)

I’m working with a well-established technology company that’s growing its engineering team and looking to connect with experienced software engineers.

This is a long-term opportunity for engineers who enjoy building production systems, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and owning meaningful technical work.

What they are looking for

- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience - Strong experience in one or more of the following: - JavaScript (React, Node.js, Angular, Vue) - Python or Golang - Java / Spring Boot - AI/ML - Solid problem-solving skills and clear communication - LATAM/US/Canada-based candidates preferred

Next steps If this sounds like a fit, feel free to: - Email your resume to chrisjorge@fwdconsulting.org, or - Apply directly via this form: https://form.jotform.com/250488763186166

Happy to share more details with qualified candidates. Thanks for reading.
